models.author: Gravity Jack
models.licenseEvidence: License, author and source embedded in original GLB asset.extras; creator listing also CC Attribution.
models.originalDescription: This American symbol has been recreated in 3D using ZBrush and Maya. Highly detailed and textured for PBR using Substance Painter. Its 100% UV unwrapped and game ready.
modifications: Centered x/z bounding box and placed statue base at y=0.
Uniformly scaled statue mesh height to 46.05 metres; this does not certify every model dimension.
Converted indexed geometry, normals and UVs to JSON, rounded positions and normals to 5 decimal places and UVs to 6.
Downsampled two original base color texture maps to at most 1024 pixels and JPEG quality 88.
Original normal and metallic-roughness maps omitted; roughness/metalness approximated for lightweight browser rendering.
Rotated -90 degrees about Y to normalize front to +Z; verified rendered front, back, left and right views.

Created 1,800-triangle Canvas LOD by welding coincident positions and quadric-error edge collapse; sampled source base-color textures for per-face colour. Simplification changes shape and is for navigation preview only.

orientation.normalization: Source front +X was rotated -90 degrees about Y to face +Z.
